sum: Solmate Infrastructure Public Limited Company operates as an institutional digital infrastructure and crypto-asset company focusing on the Solana network, building high-performance validators and digital-asset treasury assets. The company offers digital infrastructure solutions, validator operations, treasury management, and network-optimization services. Solmate Infrastructure Public Limited Company was formerly known as Brera Holdings PLC and changed its name to Solmate Infrastructure Public Limited Company in October 2026. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Dublin, Ireland.
